increment.rule: Overall success cannot set publication, deployment, browser, shareAllowed, productionReady, or user acceptance. Derive each named claim from its own required steps and proof predicates.

minimumTrial: Bind the publication claim to Chromium installation and exact-byte verify/publish/HTTPS reread steps.
Preserve skipped/missing conclusions in the receipt.
Require shareAllowed=true, deployed=true, and publicBrowserPassed=true for PUBLICATION_COMPLETE.
Have an independent verifier sign the claim result.
boundaries: Do not change R2 globally from this history replay.
Do not classify every skipped step as a failure.
Do not change production branches or current Stone Money publication status.

actualTrial.note: N26 was run by the coordinator against a real later Mother execution. The production Mother did not implement the required final closure fields; ACKNOWLEDGED/IMPLEMENTED/ADOPTED remain false.
